value.message: Naperville Gymnastics runs Parent & Tot for toddlers 18-36 months, their site says, and The Little Gym of Naperville has parent-child classes from 4 months; Fort Hill's Parent Tot Playtime is Fridays 12-1, per Naperville Park District's open gym page, though not confirmed for winter. I could not get into their pages today for days or prices, so I'll keep watching and text you what I find.
